description: Build EVM calldata offline: function selector + ABI-encoded arguments from a human signature such as transfer(address,uint256) or exactInputSingle((address,address,uint24,address,uint256,uint256,uint160)). Tuples/structs, fixed and dynamic arrays, bytes, strings and signed ints supported. mode=params gives abi.encode without a selector, mode=packed gives abi.encodePacked plus its keccak256 (as used for hashes and signatures). Returns hex, 32-byte words and length. Price: $0.003 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/abi-encode

args.description: Arguments as a JSON array (nested arrays for arrays/tuples; big integers as strings; bytes as 0x-hex)

mode.description: call = selector + abi.encode, params = abi.encode only, packed = abi.encodePacked

signature.description: Function signature, e.g. transfer(address,uint256); param names allowed; for mode=params/packed just the type list, e.g. (address,uint256)

name: abi_encode
title: Abi Encode
